title: Clarify and Cut: 90-Day Slimline and All-Hands Playbook (draft)
body:
Purpose and context:
This is a working draft for a tightened 90-day company plan ("slimline") that pairs a clear exec narrative with an operational 'cut and commit' list. Goal is to reduce cognitive load across teams, surface the minimal set of cross-company bets, and create a repeatable all-hands + exec update cadence that drives fast decisions and clean tradeoffs.

Why now:
- Q1 showed too many parallel micro-bets (lots of inter-team work with unclear owners).
- Observability and SLAs are improving but are not translating into cost/prioritization decisions quickly.
- Sales/CS feedback: customers ask for predictable latency and integration SDK stability — that suggests we should bias near-term bandwidth to reliability and rollouts rather than exploratory feature work.

Top-line 90-day thesis (one sentence):
Focus on three cross-company initiatives that materially lower time-to-production or cost per token for top customer cohorts, and stop 6 lower-impact initiatives to free up ~25% of cross-functional capacity.

Three prioritized initiatives (owners and short metric):
1) Inference Economics: Dynamic batching + prefix cache pilot (owner: Ethan Brooks)
   - Success metric: 20% reduction in tokens-per-dollar for Hosted API p95 real traffic by end of Q2.
   - Key deliverables: pilot infra rollout (week 3), SDK opt-in toggle (week 5), canary traffic (week 6).

2) Enterprise Rollout Kit (owner: Marta Alvarez)
   - Success metric: remove 3 friction points in Private onboarding (network docs, KMS checklist, sample infra templates) and reduce average onboarding time from 14->8 days for pilot customers.
   - Key deliverables: VPC checklist, automations for KMS rotation samples, internal SRE runbook.

3) Observable Quality Baseline (owner: Samir Patel)
   - Success metric: establish 20 core eval prompts (company-curated) for regression alerts; zero high-severity model regressions without rollback within 72 hours.
   - Key deliverables: prompt set curated, alerting runbook, dashboard tiles in Redwood Console.

Cut list (stop or deprioritize immediately) — proposed for exec signoff:
- Four small prototyping projects across product teams that lack customer pull: Chat-extender plugin prototypes (2), UI experiment A/B (1), non-critical alpha SDK feature (1).
- Internal initiative: non-critical telemetry enrichment (unscoped) to be postponed until after pilot completion.
- Rationale: freeing focused engineering and SRE cycles for initiatives above; this is expected to free ~120 engineering days across the next 90 days.

Ops and resourcing ask (specific):
- Execs: agree to the cut list and reallocate 60% of freed cross-team capacity to Inference Economics and 40% to Enterprise Rollout Kit.
- Finance: temporary reallocation of $75k budget (one-off) to cover pilot GPU spikes (Ethan).
- Talent: two temporary SRE contractors for 8 weeks to stabilize canary infra (Lena to onboard).

OKR draft (company level) — for feedback and pruning:
Objective: Make inference economics predictable and cheaper for production apps.
- KR1: Reduce p95 token cost for Hosted API top-10 routes by 20% (metric owner: Ethan).
- KR2: Ship Enterprise Rollout Kit and onboard 2 pilot customers with <8 days lead time (owner: Marta).
- KR3: Deploy quality baseline with automated regression alerts and document 3 rollback scenarios (owner: Samir).

Execution cadence and meetings:
- Weekly slimline sync (30m): owner updates only, no deep dives. Standing invite: exec sponsor + initiative owners + product ops.
- Tactical working sessions (ad hoc): deep technical sessions scheduled by owners; notes posted to Confluence.
- Biweekly exec readout (45m): 5-min owner updates, decision points only. Execs must come with yes/no, not open-ended questions.

All-Hands plan (single slide + 10-min talk + Q&A) — run-of-show:
- Slide 1 (top-line): Why we slimlined — 3 bullets (problem, thesis, ask).
- Slide 2 (the three initiatives): one-sentence description + metric + owner.
- Slide 3 (The cuts & tradeoffs): list of deprioritized items + expected capacity freed.
- Slide 4 (What we need from you): short asks to ICs and managers (e.g., volunteer for pilot, update roadmap tickets).
- Live Q&A (15 min): pre-collected questions prioritized; Slack thread for follow-ups.
- Post all-hands: one centralized follow-up doc with decisions and owners.

Communication plan and templates:
- Pre-announce (exec email): 48 hours before all-hands; include TL;DR and where to find details.
- One-pager (Confluence) for vertical teams with checklist for how changes will affect their roadmaps and who to contact.
- Slack channel: #ops-slimline-90 (read-only exec posts, owners can reply).

Risk register (short):
- Risk: customers hit regressions after batching changes. Mitigation: canary rollout, automatic rollback policy, extended monitoring for 72 hours after rollout.
- Risk: teams resist cuts. Mitigation: put expected reallocated work and opportunities in one-pager; managers to run team-level Q&A.
- Risk: insufficient SRE hours for canary stabilization. Mitigation: hire temporary contractors, shift non-urgent infra work.

Decision points for execs (must answer before next Friday):
1) Approve cut list as proposed (Y/N).
2) Approve $75k one-off reallocation for pilot GPU capacity (Y/N).
3) Approve hiring 2 SRE contractors for 8 weeks (Y/N).

Open questions / input requested from managers (note: please add replies inline in Confluence link):
- Which two customer pilots should be prioritized for the Rollout Kit? (Sales/CS input needed)
- Are there legal/compliance blockers for automated KMS templates in target accounts? (Security to confirm)
- Does SRE have capacity to support canary for week 6? If not, prioritize contractor onboarding.

Quick wins (within 10 days):
- Freeze non-essential feature branches merging into main for non-critical repos (owner: Lena).
- Ship SDK opt-in toggle for batching pilot (owner: Ethan) — simple feature flag.
- Consolidate five telemetry dashboards into two summary tiles (owner: Samir).

Appendix: one-page talking points for exec presenting at all-hands:
- Opening: "We had too many small bets — this is our move to simplify. We'll trade away some experiments now for the capacity to solve predictable customer pain points.
- Three initiatives: one line each (why it matters to customer or unit economics).
- Cuts: be explicit — list 6 items and why each is deprioritized.
- Close with: "We will report back in 30/60/90 days with measurable outcomes."

Notes to self / working items:
- Collect list of deprioritized tickets (by EOD Thu) - Marta.
- Draft exec email pre-announce (Priya) - ready Tue morning.
- Create canary rollback runbook template (Samir) - draft by next Wed.

Status / next steps:
- This is a first draft for exec feedback. Requesting exec decisions on the three items above by next Friday (2025-02-21).
- After exec signoff: publish Confluence one-pager, set calendar cadence, owners hold first weekly slimline sync next Monday.

Contact for clarifying questions: Priya Nair (product ops) — reply on this doc or ping in Slack @priya.nair.
